relations.evidence: Nesting is like creating a join from a document to documents from another data source. ... Unnesting data is the opposite of nesting. Unnesting is like creating a join from a parent document to Sub-Documents in an array within that document.

notable_absence.finding: Confirms this round's hypothesis directly: this guide introduces no new concepts at all. Every substantive term (NEST, UNNEST, FROM, JOIN, META/UNNEST_POS, ADVISE/Index Advisor) is a reused n1ql: id already minted from round 5's n1ql/ batch.
